title: Natural Products Targeting Liver X Receptors or Farnesoid X Receptor.
authors: She, Jianglian; Gu, Tanwei; Pang, Xiaoyan; Liu, Yonghong; Tang, Lan; Zhou, Xuefeng
one_liner_zh: 综述天然产物靶向核受体LXR/FXR的调节剂，虽涉及转录因子但聚焦小分子配体而非蛋白-DNA互作，仅含分子对接且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Nuclear receptors (NRs) are a superfamily of transcription factors induced by ligands and also function as integrators of hormonal and nutritional signals. Among NRs, the liver X receptors (LXRs) and farnesoid X receptor (FXR) have been of significance as targets for the treatment of metabolic syndrome-related diseases. In recent years, natural products targeting LXRs and FXR have received remarkable interests as a valuable source of novel ligands encompassing diverse chemical structures and bioactive properties. This review aims to survey natural products, originating from terrestrial plants and microorganisms, marine organisms, and marine-derived microorganisms, which could influence LXRs and FXR. In the recent two decades (2000-2020), 261 natural products were discovered from natural resources such as LXRs/FXR modulators, 109 agonists and 38 antagonists targeting LXRs, and 72 agonists and 55 antagonists targeting FXR. The docking evaluation of desired natural products targeted LXRs/FXR is finally discussed. This comprehensive overview will provide a reference for future study of novel LXRs and FXR agonists and antagonists to target human diseases, and attract an increasing number of professional scholars majoring in pharmacy and biology with more in-depth discussion.
abstract_zh: 核受体（NRs）是一类由配体诱导的转录因子超家族，同时充当激素和营养信号的整合器。在核受体中，肝X受体（LXRs）和法尼醇X受体（FXR）作为治疗代谢综合征相关疾病的靶点具有重要意义。近年来，靶向LXRs和FXR的天然产物因其多样的化学结构和生物活性特性，作为新型配体的宝贵来源而受到显著关注。本综述旨在调查来自陆生植物和微生物、海洋生物及海洋来源微生物的天然产物，这些产物可能影响LXRs和FXR。在近二十年（2000-2020年）间，从自然资源中发现了261种天然产物作为LXRs/FXR调节剂，其中109种为靶向LXRs的激动剂，38种为拮抗剂，以及72种靶向FXR的激动剂和55种拮抗剂。最后讨论了针对LXRs/FXR的期望天然产物的对接评估。这一全面概述将为未来研究针对人类疾病的新型LXRs和FXR激动剂及拮抗剂提供参考，并吸引更多药学与生物学专业学者进行更深入的探讨。
